compilerProvenance.notes: Curated repo-safe subset verified against the active compiler metadata provenance. This file may intentionally narrow compiler-valid behavior, but it is not the compiler source of truth.

notes: Canonical machine-readable safe subset for covered APEXlang component attributes. For covered shapes, templates and agent prose must not contradict this file. Packaged compiler metadata and direct compiler validation remain authoritative when they disagree with this file. For calendar settings.createLink and settings.viewEditLink, the preferred emitted contract is a structured object with required page and optional items. Existing form/report page reuse vs new page creation must be confirmed explicitly with the user, report type must be chosen explicitly for new view-link report pages, and target pages or item names must not be inferred.

propertyNotes.createLink: Preferred emitted shape: { page: <number>, items?: { <target_item>: <substitution_value> } }. page is required. Ask whether to reuse an existing form page or create a new modal form page on the same base table/view as the calendar source. Do not infer target page numbers or target item names.
propertyNotes.viewEditLink: Preferred emitted shape: { page: <number>, items?: { <target_item>: <substitution_value> } }. page is required. Ask whether to reuse an existing report page or create a new report page. If creating a new report page, ask for the report type every time. The report target must receive the calendar primary key through a dedicated page item and filter by that item.

propertyNotes.location: Required source discriminator. localDatabase requires type: sqlQuery plus sqlQuery and forbids restSource; restSource requires restSource: @alias and forbids type/sqlQuery.
propertyNotes.restSource: Required only with location: restSource and must resolve to a declared shared REST Data Source with HTTPS remote-server and exact Web Credential validForUrls evidence.

propertyNotes.cssClasses: For conditional card styling, reference only a source-projected alias whose values are restricted to an active-build allowlist of semantic Universal Theme classes.

propertyNotes.advancedFormatting: Required. Use false with title.column and true with title.htmlExpression.
propertyNotes.htmlExpression: Use APEX substitution strings in the form &COLUMN. inside cards title.htmlExpression. Do not use #COLUMN# tokens.

propertyNotes.advancedFormatting: Required. Use false with subtitle.column and true with subtitle.htmlExpression.
propertyNotes.htmlExpression: Use APEX substitution strings in the form &COLUMN. inside cards subtitle.htmlExpression. Do not use #COLUMN# tokens.

propertyNotes.advancedFormatting: Required. Use false with body.column and true with body.htmlExpression.
propertyNotes.htmlExpression: Use APEX substitution strings in the form &COLUMN. inside cards htmlExpression. Do not use #COLUMN# tokens.

propertyNotes.advancedFormatting: Required. Use false with secondaryBody.column and true with secondaryBody.htmlExpression.
propertyNotes.htmlExpression: Use APEX substitution strings in the form &COLUMN. inside cards htmlExpression. Do not use #COLUMN# tokens.

propertyNotes.authorizationScheme: Optional compiler-backed region authorization. Reference an existing shared authorization scheme when Cards data is more restricted than the page; never invent a scheme name.

propertyNotes.target: Preferred native Cards action navigation contract. Use declarative target: { page, items, clearCache } and map row values with &SOURCE_COLUMN. substitutions.
propertyNotes.targetUrl: Compiler-supported fallback only; generation should prefer declarative target.

propertyNotes.displayType: Button-only presentation. icon is required for icon and textWithIcon; hot and cssClasses are button-only.
propertyNotes.cssClasses: Button-only classes. Prefer native displayType, icon, and hot before custom classes.

propertyNotes.authorizationScheme: Optional compiler-backed region authorization. When access is restricted, reference an existing shared authorization scheme; never invent a scheme name.

conditionalRequirements.reportScope: settings.layout and settings.itemCssClasses are report-only and must be omitted in partial mode.

conditionalRequirements.payload: Emit exactly one of icon, initials, or image matching type.
conditionalRequirements.icon: Use a static Font APEX literal or an &COLUMN. substitution backed by a varchar2 SQL literal or explicit CASE allowlist whose every output is in the pinned Font APEX catalog.
conditionalRequirements.initials: Use a bare projected varchar2 source-column alias.
conditionalRequirements.image: Use a compiler-backed media object. BLOB mode requires typed blob, filename, MIME type, and last-updated columns; URL modes require application-managed file paths.
conditionalRequirements.alignment: Allowed only when position is inline.
conditionalRequirements.style: Allowed only when type is icon or initials; omit it for image.

conditionalRequirements.selectors: Use bare projected aliases for source-backed label, value, and state fields; source-backed labels use varchar2 and labels contain no HTML or event attributes.
conditionalRequirements.state: When present, state references a varchar2 column restricted to danger, warning, success, or info.

conditionalRequirements.grouping: Requires at least one child column with appearance.group=true and static orderBy beginning with grouped columns.
conditionalRequirements.reportScope: The plugin-grouping block is report-only and must be omitted in partial mode.

conditionalRequirements.focusOnly: Require a primary-key child column and omit both selection items.
conditionalRequirements.singleSelection: Require a primary-key child column plus a same-page hidden currentSelectionPageItem; omit selectAllPageItem.
conditionalRequirements.multipleSelection: Require a primary-key child column, a same-page hidden currentSelectionPageItem, and a same-page checkbox/switch selectAllPageItem.
conditionalRequirements.reportScope: The rowSelection block is report-only and must be omitted in partial mode.
The messages block is report-only and must be omitted in partial mode.
The pagination block is report-only and supports only entitiesPerPage.
